verdict.rationale: Semgrep hosts a working llms.txt at docs.semgrep.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed by probe) plus per-page .md agent-friendly docs (e.g. semgrep-docs-49, semgrep-docs-50), showing an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents actually consume this llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of a broader agent-oriented docs index beyond the single llms.txt file.
